root_idea.summary: The root centers on gathering and congregation, and by extension on a gathered district, domain, or place.
root_idea.development: Its lexical development extends from drawing things together or toward oneself to possession, bounded territory, spatial domain, and movement away from or toward a group.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the Quran-attested singular active participle citation form.

senses.definition: One who turns aside from his present company to join another company.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَى فِئَةٍ, the expression denotes separating from one group in order to make for another company of Muslims, particularly one engaged in fighting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw, collect, or gather something together, especially toward oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of property, wealth, animals, or other things that are brought together or gathered to a person; it can also describe an animal gathering its herd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To possess, hold, receive, obtain, or acquire something; also to comprise or embrace it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may indicate having something in one's possession or taking it to or for oneself; it may also be used of something that contains or comprises another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take land for oneself, mark its boundaries, and establish an exclusive right to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the territorial and boundary-marking construction of حازَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overcome, conquer, or master.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct extension of the basic verb, used of gaining mastery over something or someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach sexually or have sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative usage of the Form I verb; it is stated as a conventional construction rather than restricted here to the particular object used in the illustrative example.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drive or herd camels, whether gently or vehemently, including driving them toward water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence records both gentle and vehement driving. In the specialized water-related usage, the camels are driven during the first night toward distant water, when the driving is gentle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove a thing from its place, put it away, or place it at a distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a distinct transitive usage of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To writhe or twist about; to be restless and not remain still.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is illustrated by the twisting movement of a serpent and by restless movement on the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw, draw back, or retire to a distance from someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may describe moving aside or back from another person or place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tarry or loiter, being slow to rise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can describe wanting to rise while finding the action tedious or delayed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For two parties or divisions to turn away from one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is used of opposing parties turning away from each other in war or battle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave an appointed station or place of fighting, withdraw, or separate from a group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may describe a company abandoning its position and turning elsewhere, or a person separating from others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn toward a person or group and join it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote separating from one group in order to be with another, especially another group engaged in fighting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw oneself together and apply oneself closely to a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This construction expresses gathering one's parts together and falling upon or concentrating on the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn aside to a place or defined area; of property or animals, to gather themselves together in a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place or area is a حَيِّز, understood as a domain or spatial enclosure toward which something turns or gathers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place taken into possession and enclosed or bounded around, traditionally by a dam.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This nominal also functions as the verbal noun of حازَ, but the place sense is independently used for a possessed and bounded area.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Discursive delay, rambling, or prolix discussion before coming to the point.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an idiomatic, figurative use associated with prolonging an issue through digression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A possession, protected domain, territory, or set of limits; by extension, the central seat or principal part of a kingdom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote what is in one's possession or occupation and what one guards from encroachment, including pasture tracts or the protected territory of a community.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nature, disposition, temperament, or an inherent quality or property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The quality may be good or evil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place, spatial portion, quarter, region, or domain; also the space occupied by or containing a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can denote a room, apartment, or appurtenant part of a house. In technical usage it means the spatial portion occupied by an extended body or an indivisible atom, the inner surface of a container contiguous with what it contains, or a thing's proper natural place. In idioms it may mean one's quarter and protection, the manner or place of a process, or, in عَلَى حَيِّزِهِ, by himself or itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion of land comprehended within defined limits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is an adjective describing land enclosed or delimited as a distinct piece.

cautions: The lexical evidence records both gentle and vehement senses for حَازَ الإِبِلَ; the contrast is preserved in the camel-driving entry.
A figurative anatomical interpretation reported for حَوْزَةٌ is explicitly questioned in the same lexical discussion and is not presented as an established sense.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The reported interpretation of حَوْزَةٌ as a woman's private part is disputed by the lexical discussion itself, so it remains unassigned as an independent meaning.
